[DATE]: *MR Knie Rechts 15ch AA Klinische Inlichtingen: Op echo meniscuslijden lateraal rechterknie. Diagnostische vraagstellling: Meniscusscheur? Scan protocol (DRB) : sag intermediair gewogen seq zonder en met fs, ax/ cor pd gewogen seq fs, cor T1 gewogen seq Bevindingen: - Geen opzetting van suprapatellaire bursa doch evenwel een (niet met ruptuur verwikkelde Baker-cyste )/ multiloculaire T2-hyperintense structuur posterieur van de achterste kruisband (nabij de tibiale insertie interface posterieure capsuloligamentaire structuren) : ganglioncyste, afmetingen 1,9 x 1,2 x 0,6\~cm. - Bewaarde gewrichtsverhoudingen patellofemoraal en femorotibiaal (zowel in mediale alsook het laterale gewrichtscompartiment), oppervlakkige kraakbeen letseltje laterale patellaire facet alsook een graad 4 kraakbeenletsel mediale patellaire facet met ge ïsoleerde focus van botoedeem nabij de subchondrale beenplaat. - Aberrante horizontaal verlopende lineaire signaalalteratie corpusgedeelte laterale meniscus (zone 1>3 ) deels overgrijpend op de achterhoorn en de voorhoorn: horizontale scheur met kleine aanliggende parameniscale cyste nabij het corpus (Serie 11, Beeld 19) Verdere. Intact voorkomen van de voorste / achtste kruisband en de beide collaterale ligamenten. Besluit/conclusie: Horizontale scheur laterale meniscus. Patellaire chondromalacie.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Lesión meniscal interna rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Rotura compleja con componente principal radial prácticamente completo entre el cuerpo y cuerno
posterior del menisco medial con segmento parcialmente desplazado al receso menisco tibial.
Esto se asocia a edema las partes blandas regionales.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Edema óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial sin fracturas categóricas.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibial lateral y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales espesor parcial la faceta medial de la rótula.
Moderado derrame articular con leve sinovitis difusa.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento parcialmente desplazado al receso menisco
tibial con edema de las partes blandas regionales y edema óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.

[DATE]: MR Knie Links 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: gonalgieen li Diagnostische vraagstelling: gonarthrose li? Bevindingen: Gevorderd mediaal femorotibiaal kraakbeenlijden, met volledig kraakbeenverlies, minimale modificaties van het subchondrale bot op de posterieure 3e van de mediale tibiaplateau en aanliggende femorale condylen met volumineuze marginale osteofytose. Matig lateraal femorotibiaal kraakbeenlijden, met kraakbeenverlies mediaal op de laterale femorale condyl, marginale osteofytose. Extreem degeneratief voorkomen mediale meniscus, met belangrijk substantieverlies, extrusie van corpus uit het gewricht vlak, en remodellering van het mediale femorotibiale compartiment . Volledige scheur van de voorste kruisband met voorste schuiflade mogelijks op degeneratieve basis. Matig tot gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden met volledig kraakbeenverlies onderste 3e laterale facet patella met subchondrale geode's. M atige opzetting suprapatellaire recessus. Normaal voorkomen pezen. Besluit: Gevorderde variserende gonartrose van de linkerknie, op heden met matige gewrichtsuitstorting .

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena vidi se koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i platoa
tibije uz potpuno reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i platoa
tibije te vidljivu manju zonu subhondralnog edema posteriornog dijela kondila femura
(hondromalacija IV. stupnja). Masivni osteofiti medijalnog kondila femura i platoa tibije. Uredna
je morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog kolateralnog kompleksa, stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Blaža mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta uz vidljive sitne cistične degenerativne
promjene pri tibijalnom hvatištu.
Periligamentarni edem MCL u sklopu OA promjena.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska na degenerativnoj podlozi. Vidi se defekt
dijela tijela medijalnog meniska uz ekstruziju istog.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska (horizontalna i dominantno
longitudinalna).
Vide se fissure medijalne fasete patele koje zahvaćaju >50% površine (hondromalacija III.
stupnja).
Značajno je reducirana debljina artikulacijske hrskavice medijalne i lateralne trohleje femura.
Manja zona subhondralnog koštanog edema medijalne trohleje femura.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog platoa tibije.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu, dominantno u suprapatelarnom recessusu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne
(Bakerove) ciste.
Edem Hoffine masti - ddg. impigement.
Unutar masnog tkiva, s dorzalne strane distalne dijametafize femura vidi se cistična lezija
promjera 21 mm.
Manja količina lokulirane tekućine unutar lateraelnog dijela m. popliteusa prema
mišićno-tetivnom prijelazu te između m. popliteusa i lateralna glave m. gastrocnemiusa.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, focal radial tear at posterior horn. Meniscus extrusion to the medial gutter 4.5 mm.  
 There is diffuse low grade chondrosis both femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the  
 - Intrasubstance increased signal at ACL; low grade partial tear 
 - posterior cruciate ligament are intact.  
 There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at proximal (deep fibers).  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact.  
 Tendinosis of intra-articular popliteus tendon. 
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  - Medial meniscus; horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, focal radial tear at posterior horn. Meniscus extrusion to the medial gutter 4.5 mm. 
 - MCL; grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at proximal (deep fibers).  
 - ACL; intrasubstance increased signal at ACL; low grade partial tear 
 - Tendinosis of intra-articular popliteus tendon

> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus and suspicious of extends into the surface; obliteration of anterior horn of lateral meniscus, R/O tear.
    Linear signla intensity area in posterior horn of medial menisus without significant extending to articular surface, R/O degeneration.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line but increase interstitial signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Degeneration of knee joint with spur formation and subchondral edema; grade 2-3 chondromalacia at lateral facet of patella.
> Subcutaneous edema at infrapatellar region.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.

Impression: 
1. C/W tear of lateral meniscus.
2. Osteoarthritis of knee joint with synovitis; more prominent at lateral compartment.
3. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: knee osteoarthritis
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. There is patchy bone marrow edema in the lateral aspect of the proximal tibia, may represent bone bruise in appropriate clinical setting. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Degenerative oblique tear of the posterior horn. No meniscal extrusion. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning. No focal detect. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning. No focal detect. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage fissuring along the lateral patellar facet and central femoral trochlea. No focal detect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Fibulocollateral ligament and bicep femoris tendon are intact. There is mild edema about the distal iliotibial band..
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal tendinosis. No tear.
Patella tendon: Mild tendinosis with edema anterior to the tendon. No tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.  

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Mild edema anterior to the patellar tendon. . Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Bone marrow edema in the lateral aspect of the proximal tibia suggestive of bone bruise in appropriate clinical setting. 
2. Mild sprain of the distal iliotibial band. 
3. Acute patellar tendinitis. 
4. Degenerative medial meniscal tear.
